hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: docs/perf_budgets.json is generated, not hand-edited, so this write is refused rather than queried -- no human is being asked to adjudicate it. Writing it directly would leave numbers no run produced, and would bypass the _blessed block that records which counters moved and by how much. If a budget legitimately moved, re-record it with the bless action of session_browser.perf_budget, which recomputes every counter and derives that block itself. Read the Guards line in the failing report first: it names the optimisation the workload exists to defend.
